description: This file contains build configuration and make directives for the Linux kernel within the OpenWrt project, including kernel preparation, configuration, compilation, and image copying.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares the kernel source, either by extracting from a tarball or linking to an external kernel tree.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs/PreConfigure
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration for initramfs, modifying .config based on external CPIO or default settings.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs
methods.description: Sets up the kernel configuration for initramfs, updating .config with UID, GID, and compression options.

methods.name: Kernel/SetNoInitramfs
methods.description: Removes initramfs configuration from the kernel config.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the kernel build, copying kernel settings, and generating .config files.

methods.name: Kernel/CopyImage
methods.description: Copies the compiled kernel image and related files to the build directory.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Default
methods.description: Builds the kernel image and modules.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Initramfs
methods.description: Builds the kernel image with initramfs if configured.
